title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Charges Schedule — Fixed Late Fee and Late Fees Standing
content:
**Schedule note.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the fixed late fee follows the late fees already standing on the account, counting the late-fee entries posted in the six months before the assessment date less the late-fee reversals posted in those same six months: none standing takes the schedule's first-late fee of 15.00; two or more standing takes the schedule's repeat-late fee of 39.00; exactly one standing takes the plan's fixed late fee.

## The count

- Window: the six months before the date the late fee is assessed.
- Counted: the late-fee entries posted on the account in that window, less the late-fee reversals posted in that same window.
- A count of zero, or below zero where the reversals in the window outnumber the entries in it, means none standing.

## Fixed late fee by count

| Late fees standing (entries less reversals, six months) | Fixed late fee |
|---|---|
| 0 or fewer | 15.00 (first-late fee) |
| Exactly 1 | The plan's fixed late fee |
| 2 | 39.00 (repeat-late fee) |
| 3 or more | 39.00 (repeat-late fee) |

## Cases (hypothetical histories)

- Two late-fee entries posted in the six months and one of them reversed in that window: 1 standing, so the plan's fixed late fee.
- Two late-fee entries posted in the six months, neither reversed: 2 standing, so 39.00.
- One late-fee entry posted seven months before the assessment date and none since: it is outside the window, 0 standing, so 15.00.
- One late-fee entry posted in the window and reversed in the window: 0 standing, so 15.00.
